attempts.why: Turn 1: Incineroar out for Landorus (both Raichu's Thunderbolt and Garchomp's Earthquake do nothing to it), Mega Garchomp Earthquake; Pincurchin Protected, Raichu died to the spread hit before its Nasty Plot. Turn 2: Magearna Mega-evolved and got +1 from Pincurchin's faint but was outsped by both Ground attackers and died to Earthquake + Earth Power before firing Fleur Cannon. Turn 3: Porygon-Z killed by Earth Power + Dragon Claw before its 4x Ice Beam (Rotom Protected, untargeted). Turn 4: Earthquake triggered Aegislash's Weakness Policy and Earth Power removed it in the same turn; Rotom's Leaf Storm took Landorus to 21. Turn 5: Sludge Bomb + Dragon Claw ended Rotom. Two Ground types immune to the whole Electric lane and faster than every Electric-Terrain-independent member made the room's engine irrelevant.

ai_notes: Sensible choices throughout: Raichu attacked rather than Nasty Plot into two Ground types (its Thunderbolt was still wasted into the Incineroar slot that became Landorus - it cannot read the switch). Magearna Fleur Cannon target was Mega Garchomp (2x), correct. Rotom targeted Landorus with Leaf Storm (its best neutral hit) rather than Thunderbolt into an immune board.

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5, first-try win with 0 faints. Magearna and Porygon-Z already sit at offset 2 and are the room's real damage; the +1s go to the terrain engine and the terrain sweeper.
cooler: The concept shows: terrain visibly up for 8 turns, Surge Surfer speed real, Soul-Heart visibly ticking. But a Psychic gym's Electric room is fully answered by any two Ground types, and the plan's headline claim (priority denial) is simply not what Electric Terrain does. Cooler and more honest: have the room actually own the sleep-immunity angle it does provide (an opposing Amoonguss/Spore is the gym's cheapest counter elsewhere) and give Raichu Grass Knot or Surf, or give Rotom-Mow a second Ground-immune partner move, so a Garchomp+Landorus lead is not a free 6-0. Suggestion only, no set changes made.
legality_notes: Plan text inaccuracy: Electric Terrain does not block priority (Psychic Terrain does). Sets are legal. Magearna Mega-evolved via Magearnite (a hack-added Mega) as authored.
